title: Update the install when the app says it is stale
done: That is it: Set-up Info opens, with the commands that update the plugin.

steps.caption: After an update, the app compares the garnet-scoping plugin in Claude Code with its own version, and says when they differ.
The notice also says when the plugin is missing or turned off, or when the installation from before the plugin is still there.
Open Set-up Info, and run the two update commands in a terminal. New sessions then use the new plugin.
Your turn: press Open Set-up Info.
